title: I am making a game about Smashing ALL the Pumpkins at the patch.
author: Active_Cauliflower71
selftext:
The idea was to make pumpkin smashing feel good with thousands of procedurally generated pumpkins and the right physics to tear them apart.

https://reddit.com/link/1xbzseu/video/mgurxfy3cvwh1/player

You can try the free smash alpha test game mode today on itch . I recommend downloading to desktop if you can. A nerfed web version is available for those who cant run it on desktop. 

Some cool things I like about this project.  
1) The soft body physics of the pumpkin feel pretty good but definitely where the perf takes a dive. This is where most of the optimization effort is focused. Its not worth building in my opinion if the pumpkins smash like ceramics.  
2) All the pumpkins that you destroyed stay on the farm and rot so you can see the after math of your destruction on the patch.  


[https://mobicat.itch.io/pumpkin-patch-smash](https://mobicat.itch.io/pumpkin-patch-smash)
